remarks: Rare 3BR ranch-style, one-level corner co-op in sought-after Putnam Hill-just minutes to downtown Greenwich. Sun-filled end unit with an open layout, expansive living space, and walls of windows. Updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Spacious primary suite with walk-in closet and full bath, plus two additional bedrooms and second full bath.  Enjoy effortless lock-and-leave living with in-unit W/D, private balcony, hardwood floors, high ceilings, and generous storage. Elevator building with garage and on-site parking, set on 10 beautifully maintained acres. Maintenance includes property taxes, heat, hot water, and grounds.  Moments to Greenwich Ave, Metro-North, shops, dining, and parks-an unbeatable in-town lifestyle.
